description:
Analyze the impact of recessions on inflation using the US macroeconomic dataset (`usa.gdt`).

1. Calculate the quarterly growth rate of real GDP (`gdp`) using log-differences.
2. Create a dummy variable named 'recession' that equals 1 if GDP growth is negative (< 0) and 0 otherwise.
3. Run an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression with Inflation (`inf`) as the dependent variable and your 'recession' dummy as the independent variable (along with the constant).
4. Save the full regression output to `/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/recession_results.txt`.
